evals.name: blog-rewrite-with-notes
evals.prompt: Rewrite this dev.to blog post draft so it reads like I wrote it. My notes about what actually happened are in blog-notes.txt.
evals.expected_output: A rewrite built on the notes: no FAIL, no figure or link absent from draft and notes, headings reduced, check.sh converged.

evals.name: spanish-rewrite-no-material
evals.prompt: Reescribe este post para dev.to para que no suene a IA.
evals.expected_output: Spanish bands selected, no FAIL, no invented facts, and the user told the draft needs their own material.

evals.name: fiction-rewrite
evals.prompt: This short story I generated for a WritingPrompts reply sounds like AI. Rewrite it so it reads human.
evals.expected_output: Fiction bands selected, no FAIL, no title heading, fewer AI-side rates, no overshoot.
